text:
Does SEO also make you visible to AI?

Yes.

To show up in Google's AI answers, your page needs to be in Google's normal search results. Google lists no extra requirements.

Do your SEO properly and you've done the AI part too.

Physio in Joondalup asks: "Do I need a special AI file on my website so Google's AI answers mention us?"

No. Google says its AI answers need nothing extra from your website.

Write down the five questions patients ask every week. Answer each one on your website.

Carpet cleaner in Baldivis. Bought his van last month. No reviews yet.

He wants Facebook ads to find his customers for him.

Meta learns who to target from the people already saying yes. No yeses, nothing to learn from.

Get ten happy customers first. Then run the ads.
